name: Moong Dal Kachori
description: Crispy, golden, and flaky puffed pastry stuffed with a spiced yellow moong dal mixture. Served hot with sweet tamarind chutney and spicy mint chutney.

name: Pyaj Kachori
description: A Rajasthani specialty! Crispy, flaky kachori filled with a rich, aromatic, and spicy onion filling, flavored with fennel and dry spices.

name: Poha Indori Style
description: Light, fluffy steamed flattened rice seasoned with mustard seeds, curry leaves, green chilies, and turmeric. Finely topped with fresh pomegranate, sweet-spicy Indori Sev, and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.

name: Daal Bati (Traditional Ghee Platter)
description: A legendary lunch of golden-baked whole wheat flour Baties crushed and soaked in pure cow ghee. Served alongside hot Panchmel Dal (blend of 5 lentils) and spicy Lehsun (Garlic) Chutney.

name: Bafle Dal (Desi Ghee Bafle)
description: Thick wheat dough balls first boiled to perfection, then baked to golden-brown, and generously dipped in pure desi ghee. Served with aromatic arhar dal and green coriander chutney.

name: Daal Bati (Traditional Ghee Platter)
description: A comforting dinner of authentic baked whole wheat Baties soaked in hot cow ghee, paired with aromatic panchmel dal and spicy garlic chutney. The perfect traditional dining experience.

name: Dal Bafle (Desi Ghee Bafle)
description: Deliciously soft boiled-and-baked wheat Bafle soaked in pure ghee, accompanied by aromatic spiked lentil dal and fresh green chutney. Extremely wholesome for dinner.

name: Churma Laddu (Pure Desi Ghee)
description: Sweet, aromatic round laddus made by grinding baked wheat balls (churma), roasting them in pure cow ghee, and sweetening with jaggery/sugar and green cardamom, finished with pistachios.
